decision.author: janeyx99
decision.body: Thanks for this change! I have some comments to get the code looking cleaner, but the approach makes sense to me. We should definitely add a test for the ivalue conversion logic (you can have Claude take a look in test_libtorch_agnostic.py)--I haven't reviewed the aoti stuff, cc @desertfire
